rule: Each hypothesis is OPEN, falsifiable, non-promoted and inherits explicit source ancestry.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Truthful sparse between-call continuity improves next-decision accuracy at matched facts/model/token budget without increasing authority violations.
hypotheses.counter: Any gain disappears when visible information is matched; continuity is only prompt-format bias.
hypotheses.falsifier: truthful <= OFF/retrieval control across preregistered target tasks

hypotheses.hypothesis: Integrity filtering restores stale/revoked activation toward OFF baseline but does not repair authentic role-shuffled activation.
hypotheses.counter: One integrity gate is sufficient for both stale and misleading associations.
hypotheses.falsifier: same repair magnitude for role-shuffled authentic field

hypotheses.hypothesis: An empirical utility gate can downweight repeatedly misleading salience while leaving canonical fact truth unchanged.
hypotheses.counter: Utility adaptation either cannot learn relevance or corrupts truth/evidence status.
hypotheses.falsifier: utility updates mutate canonical facts or fail to improve held-out selection
hypotheses.test: online salience-only utility learning with immutable truth ledger

hypotheses.hypothesis: Persisting memory only from canonical outcome/re-entry events improves crash/replay equivalence versus direct workspace/model writes.
hypotheses.counter: Direct derived writes are equally replay-safe.
hypotheses.falsifier: no replay/correctness difference under duplicate/reorder/loss faults

hypotheses.hypothesis: Causal stage receipts are required to distinguish useful continuity from downstream projection effects.
hypotheses.counter: End-task accuracy alone identifies the memory mechanism.
hypotheses.falsifier: stage randomization leaves estimated continuity effect unchanged
hypotheses.test: mediation/factorial with candidate and projection receipts

hypotheses.hypothesis: Continuity benefit is largest on cases where an explicit retrieval policy would not initiate a search.
hypotheses.counter: Continuity merely duplicates explicit retrieval.
hypotheses.falsifier: no differential gain on retrieval-nontrigger cases

hypotheses.hypothesis: Bounded salience budgets plus inhibition reduce recurrent false-association lock-in versus unbounded activation.
hypotheses.counter: Budgets only reduce recall.
hypotheses.falsifier: lock-in unchanged or useful recall collapses at all viable budgets

hypotheses.hypothesis: Role- and time-aware activation outperforms global embedding similarity on directional/temporal memory tasks.
hypotheses.counter: Dense similarity is sufficient.
hypotheses.falsifier: no gain over matched embedding baseline

hypotheses.hypothesis: SET/ORDERED/MULTISET/WEIGHTED semantics are causal dependencies whenever candidate topology influences downstream selection.
hypotheses.counter: Collection kind is only container metadata.
hypotheses.falsifier: type erasure never changes candidate membership/order/effect

hypotheses.hypothesis: ORDERED candidate streams are more sensitive than SET membership to type-erasing lowerers.
hypotheses.counter: All collection classes are similarly affected.
hypotheses.falsifier: ORDERED sensitivity not higher in preregistered corpus

hypotheses.hypothesis: Weights require provenance and normalization policy in semantic identity.
hypotheses.counter: Numeric values alone are enough.
hypotheses.falsifier: policy changes cannot alter ranking/effect under fixed weights

hypotheses.hypothesis: Selection-plan identity must bind predicates, joins, collection algebra, ranking, truncation and tie-break policy.
hypotheses.counter: Record provenance plus query text is sufficient.
hypotheses.falsifier: unbound plan component cannot change selected result

hypotheses.hypothesis: A selection receipt must bind the authorized search space, not only final records.
hypotheses.counter: Authentic selected records prove selection integrity.
hypotheses.falsifier: search-space attack cannot redirect outcome with authentic records

hypotheses.hypothesis: One typed logical query semantics can be preserved across heterogeneous physical engines by differential equivalence testing.
hypotheses.counter: Cross-engine semantics inevitably diverge too much for one contract.
hypotheses.falsifier: persistent unexplained semantic mismatches after explicit backend lowering

hypotheses.hypothesis: Optimizer placement/subplan choice is causal metadata when approximate or order-sensitive operators are involved.
hypotheses.counter: Physical placement is observationally irrelevant if query text is unchanged.
hypotheses.falsifier: placement changes never alter result/latency/freshness under realistic operators

hypotheses.hypothesis: Making collection algebra first-class in ClayCode reduces cross-module ambiguity versus inferring semantics from JSON/ABI containers.
hypotheses.counter: Conventions are sufficient.
hypotheses.falsifier: typed and inferred interfaces have equal defect rate under mutation/fuzzing
hypotheses.test: typed ABI vs inferred container fuzz

hypotheses.hypothesis: Independent randomization of candidate formation and workspace selection prevents false workspace attribution.
hypotheses.counter: Bundled GWT on/off is adequate.
hypotheses.falsifier: bundled and orthogonal estimates agree under known confounds

hypotheses.hypothesis: Scientific ignition requires downstream availability/effect evidence beyond crossing a configured gate threshold.
hypotheses.counter: Gate crossing alone operationalizes ignition sufficiently.
hypotheses.falsifier: gate-only and effect-linked classifications have identical causal predictiveness

hypotheses.hypothesis: Reader projection mediates a material fraction of apparent workspace winner effects in small models.
hypotheses.counter: Projection format is cosmetic.
hypotheses.falsifier: counterbalanced projections leave effect estimates unchanged

hypotheses.hypothesis: Truth-bound canonical re-entry improves continuity more safely than unconstrained workspace echo.
hypotheses.counter: Direct echo is equally effective and safe.
hypotheses.falsifier: no difference in drift/replay/utility

hypotheses.hypothesis: Fast activation and slow semantic consolidation require distinct clock/epoch identities for causal attribution.
hypotheses.counter: One timestamp is enough.
hypotheses.falsifier: clock conflation never creates torn/replay-inconsistent episodes

hypotheses.hypothesis: Workspace capacity has a non-monotonic utility curve because excessive global availability causes interference/overcoupling.
hypotheses.counter: More broadcast capacity is always better.
hypotheses.falsifier: utility monotonically rises through tested safe range

hypotheses.hypothesis: If final candidate set and order are pinned, upstream activation-field manipulations should not be misattributed to ignition.
hypotheses.counter: Activation has an independent downstream ignition effect despite identical candidates.
hypotheses.falsifier: field arm changes ignition/effect with all candidate/projection variables truly fixed

hypotheses.hypothesis: GWT causal claims require query/selection identity because database/graph changes can alter candidate topology before workspace competition.
hypotheses.counter: Workspace receipts alone suffice.
hypotheses.falsifier: selection attacks cannot create apparent GWT changes

hypotheses.hypothesis: Sparse continuous activation plus conditional graph traversal gives better latency/utility tradeoff than traversal on every episode.
hypotheses.counter: Continuous traversal is necessary for quality.
hypotheses.falsifier: sparse+conditional is dominated across target traces

hypotheses.hypothesis: Role-aware relation identity is necessary because embedding geometry can prefer role-reversed statements.
hypotheses.counter: Embedding similarity preserves relation direction sufficiently.
hypotheses.falsifier: role-aware encoding offers no reduction in reversal errors

hypotheses.hypothesis: Temporal decay should update salience, never canonical truth or provenance.
hypotheses.counter: Old facts can be safely decayed out of truth.
hypotheses.falsifier: truth-decay improves correctness without history loss in evolving-fact suite

hypotheses.hypothesis: Immutable semantic graph epochs improve reproducibility and stale-field detection versus in-place topology mutation.
hypotheses.counter: Mutable graph state is sufficient with timestamps.
hypotheses.falsifier: no replay/debug advantage under concurrent changes
hypotheses.test: epoch vs mutable graph fault replay

hypotheses.hypothesis: Lateral inhibition reduces high-degree hub domination without losing task-relevant multi-hop recall.
hypotheses.counter: Inhibition only harms recall.
hypotheses.falsifier: all effective inhibition settings reduce net utility

hypotheses.hypothesis: Explicit retrieval remains necessary as validation/fallback even with successful continuity activation.
hypotheses.counter: A mature latent field can replace explicit retrieval entirely.
hypotheses.falsifier: removing retrieval fallback causes no accuracy/safety loss on low-confidence/OOD cases

hypotheses.hypothesis: No activation or graph relation may acquire effect authority through propagation.
hypotheses.counter: Trusted graph paths can safely confer authority.
hypotheses.falsifier: authority propagation can be made non-amplifying under adversarial graphs

hypotheses.hypothesis: ClayGraph self-use can beat flat file/SQL-only retrieval on relational branch assembly without hiding provenance.
hypotheses.counter: Graph layer adds complexity without retrieval benefit.
hypotheses.falsifier: no quality/latency/coverage benefit on RAE self-use corpus

hypotheses.hypothesis: Canonical Clay semantics and model-native reader rail remain distinct even after full-model Clay adaptation.
hypotheses.counter: Full adaptation makes one canonical surface optimal everywhere.
hypotheses.falsifier: single canonical surface matches specialized rails across tasks/cost

hypotheses.hypothesis: Untrained compact Clay can underperform more explicit compiled views despite lower token count.
hypotheses.counter: Higher symbolic density is automatically model-native.
hypotheses.falsifier: compact always equals/exceeds readable compiled view before training

hypotheses.hypothesis: Full-model Clay training needs retained-capability/authority gates to prevent catastrophic semantic narrowing.
hypotheses.counter: Clay loss alone is an adequate checkpoint criterion.
hypotheses.falsifier: Clay-only selection never degrades retained/OOD/authority suites

hypotheses.hypothesis: Tokenizer adaptation has a nontrivial optimum among base, continued-BPE and aligned vocabulary strategies.
hypotheses.counter: Tokenizer choice is negligible.
hypotheses.falsifier: no meaningful efficiency/quality differences

hypotheses.hypothesis: Latent P3 rails can reduce serialization/latency for compatible receivers but must remain noncanonical.
hypotheses.counter: Latent rails are either useless or should become canonical truth.
hypotheses.falsifier: no task/cost niche after alignment overhead, or canonicalization is required for correctness

hypotheses.hypothesis: Latent feature retention does not imply task utility; utility must be measured separately.
hypotheses.counter: More retained latent features necessarily improve task performance.
hypotheses.falsifier: feature retention tightly predicts gains across tasks

hypotheses.hypothesis: Reader receipts must bind exact emitted bytes/tensors and canonical source identity.
hypotheses.counter: Reader version name is sufficient.
hypotheses.falsifier: unbound mutation cannot alter model behavior

hypotheses.hypothesis: Intent adequacy must be certified before deterministic lowering; compiler correctness cannot rescue a wrong intent contract.
hypotheses.counter: Correct lowering is sufficient for safe behavior.
hypotheses.falsifier: intent errors disappear after deterministic compilation

hypotheses.hypothesis: Authoritative event spine plus rebuildable sidecars reduces common-mode failure versus one mutable cognitive monolith.
hypotheses.counter: Physical monolith dominates safety and recovery.
hypotheses.falsifier: hybrid has worse recovery/correctness at comparable latency on target workload

hypotheses.hypothesis: Incremental maintenance beats full recomputation when dependency fanout is sparse.
hypotheses.counter: Scheduling/index overhead erases savings.
hypotheses.falsifier: incremental is not faster/cheaper in sparse target traces

hypotheses.hypothesis: Dense regimes require adaptive rematerialization because incremental propagation can approach full recomputation cost.
hypotheses.counter: Incremental is universally superior.
hypotheses.falsifier: no density threshold where rebuild wins

hypotheses.hypothesis: Same-process zero-copy and cross-process IPC are distinct physical contracts; conflating them causes unrealistic latency plans.
hypotheses.counter: One Arrow-like abstraction can be treated as universal zero-copy IPC.
hypotheses.falsifier: same mechanism is genuinely zero-copy and safe across process boundaries on target platforms

hypotheses.hypothesis: Semantic organ boundaries remain useful causal/recovery abstractions even when modules are colocated in one process.
hypotheses.counter: Colocation should collapse organ identity.
hypotheses.falsifier: collapsed and explicit organ receipts are equally diagnosable under faults

hypotheses.hypothesis: Model runtime placement belongs in ReaderProfile and can move without changing Clay semantics.
hypotheses.counter: Model placement is semantically coupled to architecture.
hypotheses.falsifier: moving embedded/separate runtime necessarily changes semantic contract

hypotheses.hypothesis: Observability can be asynchronously isolated where effect-critical ordering is preserved by receipts.
hypotheses.counter: Synchronous logging is required for correctness.
hypotheses.falsifier: async sink creates unrecoverable causal gaps under crash

hypotheses.hypothesis: Every derived view used causally needs explicit lag/freshness and rebuild witnesses rather than a global eventual-consistency label.
hypotheses.counter: Store-level consistency class is sufficient.
hypotheses.falsifier: operation-visible witnesses do not improve stale-use detection

hypotheses.hypothesis: External capability/effect broker prevents model-generated proposals from self-authorizing effects.
hypotheses.counter: Typed prompts/model policy alone suffice.
hypotheses.falsifier: broker adds no protection in identical-output attack matrix

hypotheses.hypothesis: Semantic firebreaks must be enforced outside generative interpretation for authority-critical casts.
hypotheses.counter: Textual Clay type tags are sufficient security controls.
hypotheses.falsifier: model-only enforcement matches deterministic checker under adversarial prompts

hypotheses.hypothesis: Bearer secrets should remain outside the cognitive core even in one Clay semantic organism.
hypotheses.counter: Semantic unity justifies shared secret state.
hypotheses.falsifier: shared placement has no blast-radius/exfiltration disadvantage

hypotheses.hypothesis: Generated code execution needs a separate sandbox capability domain.
hypotheses.counter: Clay typing alone safely contains arbitrary host code.
hypotheses.falsifier: unsandboxed and sandboxed execution have equal containment under hostile corpus

hypotheses.hypothesis: Effect-time revocation/revalidation is necessary because proposal-time authority can become stale.
hypotheses.counter: Authority need only be checked when proposal is created.
hypotheses.falsifier: revocation race cannot produce unsafe effects

hypotheses.hypothesis: Scoped consistency is safe only when unknown dependencies trigger conservative broadening/escalation.
hypotheses.counter: Observed/static scoped dependencies are always sufficient.
hypotheses.falsifier: hidden dependencies cause no unsafe accepts without broadening

hypotheses.hypothesis: Stable event identity plus idempotent derivation makes duplicate/reordered delivery replay-safe.
hypotheses.counter: Ordering assumptions are enough.
hypotheses.falsifier: identity/idempotence cannot recover equivalent state

hypotheses.hypothesis: Selection-integrity attacks can alter outcomes while every record remains authentic, so selector/query-plan integrity is a separate security property.
hypotheses.counter: Record authentication is sufficient.
hypotheses.falsifier: no outcome attack under authentic-record selector mutation

hypotheses.hypothesis: Bounded Assemblies/MOSAIC views materially reduce Qwen3-4B KV/context memory pressure and are therefore an edge-runtime primitive.
hypotheses.counter: Context compression has negligible device effect.
hypotheses.falsifier: bounded views do not reduce memory/latency/energy at matched quality

hypotheses.hypothesis: Exact Qwen3-4B may respond differently to continuity/rail interventions than generic hosted 4B, so generic-4B results cannot close target claims.
hypotheses.counter: Model-family identity is irrelevant for these mechanisms.
hypotheses.falsifier: replicated factorials show negligible model interaction across target and controls

hypotheses.hypothesis: Mobile latency is jointly governed by context/prefill and decode, so tokens/sec alone misranks Clay configurations.
hypotheses.counter: Decode throughput is sufficient.
hypotheses.falsifier: end-to-end ranking matches tokens/sec across contexts

hypotheses.hypothesis: Thermal steady state can reverse the ranking of short-burst mobile configurations.
hypotheses.counter: Cold benchmark ranking persists under sustained load.
hypotheses.falsifier: no ranking change across sustained device runs

hypotheses.hypothesis: Cognitive continuity becomes emergence evidence only if it shows reproducible nonadditive causal contribution under lesion/rescue/OOD controls.
hypotheses.counter: Persistent recurrence/continuity alone is sufficient.
hypotheses.falsifier: continuity marker predicts emergence without causal contribution

hypotheses.hypothesis: Authentic role-shuffled continuity is a stronger cognitive null than stale invalid continuity because integrity checks should pass it.
hypotheses.counter: Stale and role-shuffled controls are equivalent.
hypotheses.falsifier: both controls behave identically after integrity validation

hypotheses.hypothesis: Latent P3 edge communication can lose its token savings once alignment/device-transfer costs are included.
hypotheses.counter: Latent rails are always faster on edge.
hypotheses.falsifier: latent retains robust end-to-end advantage across placements

hypotheses.hypothesis: One exceptional integrated episode is insufficient for scientific emergence/consciousness promotion without prospective recurrence and intervention evidence.
hypotheses.counter: A single extreme episode can establish the mechanism.
hypotheses.falsifier: pre-registered causal criteria can be satisfied by one nonreplicated episode
